theorem boundaryLimits_eq_extension {f : SpaceTime → V} (hzero : VanishingJointJets f)
    (hext : AwayExtensions f) {x : Space} (e : OneSidedExtension f x) (n : ℕ) :
    boundaryLimits f hext x n = iteratedFDeriv ℝ n e.value (1, x)
